current_milestone.title: Final real-human Web and n8n evaluation
current_milestone.outcome: Phase 5 passed locally and in public branch CI. The dual-surface protocol is frozen; zero real-human sessions exist and participant consent and coordination are required before execution.

commands.summary: The exact Phase 5 candidate passed backend, frontend and container jobs, including the actual n8n form/webhook and bounded failure fixture.

commands.command: uv lock --check; ruff format/check; mypy --strict; pytest -q; validate_contracts.py
commands.summary: Phase 5 local gate passed: 197 tests, 92 strictly typed source files, 9 active V1.5 schemas, preserved frozen packages and 11 PNG screenshots.

commands.command: npm lint/typecheck/test/build; Playwright mocked E2E and live-backend E2E
commands.summary: Four frontend unit tests, three mocked journeys including terminal abstention, and three real-backend filing journeys passed with no critical accessibility errors.
Fresh API/frontend images built after two transient BuildKit registry timeouts; the reproducible launcher then started and smoke-tested PostgreSQL, API, Web and n8n.

commands.command: n8n import/publish; python -m scripts.n8n_smoke; test-only transport failure fixture
commands.summary: Actual n8n 2.37.9 passed three identical-backend cases, native form success/refusal, replay, minimum input, five HTTP failures and five transport-only failure scenarios.

commands.command: node workflow generation/check; 10 Node groups; integration ESLint
commands.summary: Portable dual-trigger workflow is generated from reviewable Code nodes; routing, escaping, bounds and unchanged webhook output pass.

next_action.title: Coordinate six real participants and run the frozen dual-surface protocol
next_action.why: Real-human evidence is the only remaining product prerequisite before Release Freeze; AI simulation cannot substitute for it.
next_action.first_step: The owner arranges at least six consenting target users and schedules balanced Web+n8n sessions without storing identities or private contact details in Git.
acceptance_evidence: At least six eligible consenting real target users remain in the frozen denominator.
Groups are counterbalanced and both Web and n8n use the same ResearchForge backend.
Independent, assisted, failed and not-attempted outcomes are recorded without hiding failures.
The deterministic summary meets the thresholds frozen before recruitment.

blockers.description: Phase 6 requires at least six consenting real target users; zero sessions exist and Codex cannot fabricate or substitute them.
blockers.owner_action: Arrange at least six consenting individual researchers, finance learners or junior researchers and schedule the frozen Web+n8n sessions; do not send identities or private contact details into the repository.

last_session.summary: Closed Phase 5 after the exact candidate passed local gates and all public GitHub Actions jobs. Phase 6 is ready but not started because human sessions remain zero.
